sections.admission_summary: Chief complaint: Nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, polyuria, altered consciousness. Admitted for inpatient care.
sections.discharge_instructions: Drink plenty of fluids. Get adequate rest and avoid overexertion. Follow up with PCP in 7-10 days. Complete prescribed medications as directed. Return to ER if symptoms worsen. Follow diabetic diet plan; maintain hydration especially during illness (small sips frequently). Check blood glucose 4-6 times daily; check urine or blood ketones if BG >250 mg/dL. Return to ER for BG >300 mg/dL with ketones, persistent vomiting, deep breathing, or altered mental status. Gradual return to normal activity. Maintain balanced diet and adequate hydration.
sections.follow_up: Follow up with PCP in 7-10 days.
